Definition of
SOVD
data
SOVD data is defined by the
DiagnosticSovdContent
, which itself, is composed
out of one or more
DiagnosticSovdContentElement
(s). The DM uses the inter-
face
ara::diag::GenericDiagnosticSovdContent
to read or write the entire
data, while applying the data conversion rules defined in Chapter 7.3.3.3.2 “SOVD
Data – Conversion”.
[SWS_DM_01432]
SOVD
method
Read a data resource
from an Entity – data
query
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04260
⌈
If the SOVD method
Read a data ressource
is received, the DM shall call the
corresponding
ara::diag::GenericDiagnosticSovdContent::Read
method
and send a response body according to ASAM SOVD [5][14] and set the following
attribute values:
id
to
shortName
of
DiagnosticSovdContent
,
data
as enumeration of all
DiagnosticSovdContentElement
s aggregated by the
DiagnosticSovdContent
with:
ValueName
set to the
shortName
of the DiagnosticSovdContentElement
Value
retrieved by [SWS_DM_02165]
⌋
[SWS_DM_02164] Retrieval of
SOVD
content
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04260
⌈
To read SOVD data, the DM shall use the
ara::diag::GenericDiagnos-
ticSovdContent::Read
method that is mapped via
DiagnosticSovdContent-
PortMapping
.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02165] Retrieval of
SOVD
content element data
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04260
⌈
To retrieve the
value
of an
DiagnosticSovdContentElement
, the DM shall eval-
uate the
DiagnosticSovdContentElementData
provided by [SWS_DM_02164]
and retrieve the
data
of the requested
DiagnosticSovdContentElement
(s)
from the returned
DiagnosticSovdContentElementData
object, by fetching
the content via
ara::diag::DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey::
GetContent
, while
ara::diag::DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWith-
Key::GetName
is matching the
shortName
of the
DiagnosticSovdContentEle-
ment
.
⌋
